title: InfraBuild Trading Pty Ltd - Best Bar Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced informal review under the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines.
ACCC is awaiting further information from the acquirer. Former provisional date for announcement of findings (10 June) is delayed.

The ACCC determined the new date of announcement of its findings (as outlined in the Informal Merger Review Process Guidelines, this may be a final decision or release of a Statement of Issues) as 25 June.
The ACCC discontinued this review after InfraBuild withdrew its application for informal merger clearance.
